we present FairTest, a tool for discovering unwarranted associations in data-driven applications, and that we demonstrate the effectiveness of FairTest on four applications.

we introduce the unwarranting associations (UA) formalism, which unifies prior work in algorithmic fairness, and instantiate it in FairTest, a tool for the detection of unfair user treatment in data driven applications.

the FairTest framework and tool are effective at identifying and debugging unfair associations in data-driven applications and that the use of the FairTest tool has led to improvements in the fairness of the applications we studied.

the UA framework and FairTest provide a principled, scalable, and practical methodology for discovering and debugging unfair or offensive user treatment arising from data-driven applications.
